blocks.text: Life by the Shore at Boundary Beach

parts.t: Boundary Beach is at the south end of Tsawwassen, on Boundary Bay, right next to the BC-Washington border. Homes go from old beach cottages to big newer houses. Some have beach access or views across the bay.

Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach are next door for walks. The dyke trail is good for biking and birdwatching. Tsawwassen's shops are a few minutes away by car. Contact me for current Boundary Beach homes for sale and recent sales.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
